features: boAt 360 ̊ Spatial Audio: Step into a world of sound that surrounds you with boAt 360 ̊ Spatial Audio on the boAt Rockerz Prime 415 Bluetooth Headphones. Whether you are vibing to your favorite playlist or bingeing your watchlist, these headphones are sure to take you on an immersive audio adventure!

Up to 120 Hours of Playback: Keep the beats alive for days with up to 120 hours of non-stop playtime. From morning commutes to weekend jams, enjoy endless music, calls, and entertainment without worrying about charging woes.
40mm Drivers: Feel the pulse of your music with power-packed 40mm drivers that deliver boAt Signature Sound with deep bass. Each beat hits harder, ensuring a rich and dynamic listening experience.

AI-ENx Technology: Stay connected with crystal-clear calls no matter where you are. Boasting advanced AI-ENx tech, these headphones filter out background noise, making your voice heard clearly in bustling cafés, airports, or offices.
BEAST Mode: Level up your gaming sessions with BEAST Mode, featuring 40ms ultra-low latency for a lag-free performance. Dominate every match with precision sound synced perfectly to your gameplay.
